question: Accept validation PASSED for the widened dispatch build-count bar, and finalize 6ht?

artifacts.summary: Validation ran a 12-shape adversarial matrix through the real observation and assertion path in a throwaway checkout. The widened bar keeps teeth: byte-identical rebuild (waste), three successes (flailing), two different failures then a success, success then a failed differing rebuild, and a build that never finished all stay RED, alongside the five pre-existing scripted controls. Falsifiability reproduced independently — reverting the rule to strict 1/1 fails both real-occurrence rows and the replay control. The +94-vs-+30 overrun was traced line by line to approved design bullets and verbatim test-plan items, one file, zero production code. Two deferred risks: cosmetic argv differences (flag reorder, doubled space, repeated boolean flag) and a rebuild naming a different --stage pass the correction test, which is raw-string inequality. Neither has an observed or reachable trigger; both carry promote conditions.
